implementation_strategy: Seeded synthetic topology and intent generation -> single shared initial LLM generation per task (baseline candidate) via hosted OpenAI API (gpt-5-mini) -> deterministic canonicalizer and validator executed in CPU Docker container -> if validator fails, run at most one guarded repair LLM call (generate_validate_repair_v1) -> deterministic re-validation. All code, validators and runbook packaged in Docker images with pinned deps; results and manifests recorded and published.
task_manifest_strategy: Deterministic seeded topology_synthesis and intent_generation producing N=300 confirmatory tasks (75 per intent cluster) with seeds recorded; automatic redaction filters applied; canonicalizer/unit tests executed prior to confirmatory run.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Transformation implementations for direct_configuration_generation_v1 and generate_validate_repair_v1 are versioned in the repository; canonicalizer and validator are deterministic, CPU-executable, and included in Docker images.
execution_batches: 10 batches of 30 tasks each (batch sequencing deterministic by seed).
randomisation_plan: Fixed pseudo-random seeds per task assigned at preregistration; seed list embedded in run manifest to ensure deterministic reproducibility; no additional randomisation during paired comparisons.
caching_plan: Cache all LLM responses, canonicalized outputs, validator results, and manifests in immutable artifact store; Docker images and SHA-256 hashes stored; cached artifacts used to avoid duplicate model calls during replays.
failure_recovery_plan: One automated retry for transient provider/API errors within 60s; if retry fails, mark call failed and proceed per preregistered missingness_plan. All retries, timestamps, and error codes logged in execution manifest.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 — per-task paired record containing task_id, seed, shared_initial_candidate, baseline_outcome (validator pass/fail), guarded_outcome (validator pass/fail), guarded_repair_invocations (0|1), canonicalized_outputs, diagnostics, SHA-256 hashes, timestamps.
estimated_compute_notes: Totals: task_count=300. Per-adapter contract model calls between 1 and 2 per task; estimated expected repair rate ~50% -> estimated_model_calls = 300 * 1.5 = 450. Maximum_model_calls = 300 * 2 = 600 (aligned with adapter contract and capability manifest). Validators run on CPU in Docker; hosted API call budget within manifest (≤10,000). Wall-clock execution targeted ≤7 days.
